title: baaghe aalam me shabbir aaye
body:
baaghe aalam me shabbir aaye, har kali baagh ki has rahi hai
chal rahi hai naseeme masarrat, daali daali har ek jhoomti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
gulshane dee'n bahaarou pe aaya, abr rehmat ka hai aaj chaaya
baaghe nasle imamat hai qandaa'n yu'n naseeme masarrat chali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maah roo hai ali ka ye bacha, is ka jalwa hai yasrab me paida
chand aaya hai ye fatima ka, ghar me hyder ke ab chaandni hai
<<DIVIDER>>
azm se ye na hargiz hatega, teghe shehrag se batil katega
hai jigar me to hamza ki quwwat, qalb me himmate hyderi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ka taqt tewar se larza, hogaya hai tabaahi ka imkaa'n
ye to doure yazeedi nahi hai, daste bayyat me kyu thartharayi
<<DIVIDER>>
aa chuke the nabi aur hyder, the hassan aur binte payambar
isse taadaad daare jaha'n me, panjetan ki mukammal hui
<<DIVIDER>>
ye na raahe quda se hatega, naame haq isse baaqi rahega
ye ekhattar 17 ko lekar ladega, iski rag rag me qoone ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
surq rooi shariyat ki beshak, hai ataa e libas e hussaini
husne range libaase hassan se, deene ahmad ki kheti hari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sab hi darham ko dete rahenge, bheek sab se hi lete rahenge
teesra dar to ye hai usi ka, jo imamat ki baara dari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye dunya me dil bande hyder, jism jhule se ab jaake mas kar
baal o par le tasadduq me jaa kar, dekh fitrus ye achi ghadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hai farzand aisa ali ka girte kaabe ko jisne sambhala
ye to bacha nahi murtaza ka, deene islam ki zindagi hai
